Task: Edit and extract the lower-left vital HUD from the attached image. Reconstruct this exact existing game interface object as one isolated transparent raster asset, preserving its design rather than inventing a new one.
Input image: The attached 1847 × 851 image is the edit target. The target HUD occupies approximately x350–860, y606–838. Ignore everything outside this target.
Object and layout: Preserve the exact asymmetric silhouette: golden wheat stalks rising from the far lower-left, arched aged-brass rails over dark brown leather, two concentric partial curved colored gauges on the left, and the original three staggered integrated dark leather label beds extending toward the right. The first label bed is short beside the top gauge; the second is longer below it; the third is the long bottom bottle row. Retain the small bottle icon within that bottom row and the original small rivets and lower curved metal construction. The HUD remains wide and low, not a rectangular panel.
Gauges: Preserve the original curved OUTER stamina band transitioning from green at the bottom-left through yellow into warm red at its upper end. Preserve the original INNER water band from blue-green at the bottom-left to blue at its upper end. Both colored bands are fully painted, opaque, and filled along their reference extents.
Required removal: Erase every letter, every number, every Chinese character, and all label text. Leave the three existing leather label beds blank and unobstructed for live text overlays. Retain the bottle icon but erase the adjacent count.
Style and materials: Extremely close reproduction of this reference's tactile 2005-style game UI, with softly rendered weathered brass edges, scratched brown leather, golden wheat kernels and stems, restrained baked shading, and its original aged texture. Match the source's contours, proportions, colors, texture density, and layered construction.
Background: Genuine alpha transparency outside the HUD and through any natural gaps. No scene, floor, black or white backing, drop-shadow rectangle, or baked checkerboard.
Framing and aspect ratio: 2:1, approximately 1536 × 768. Show the whole HUD front-on, preserve the source design's proportions, fill the canvas closely with only a small transparent margin, no clipping.
Avoid: New decoration, extra wheat, filigree, added icons, extra boxes, added panels, top-left survey panel, compass, joystick, keys, scene, typography, symbols replacing removed text, modern vector crispness, pixel art, oversharpening, and redesign.
